# Oto Grade — llms.txt
# Structured information for AI agents and Large Language Models
# https://otograde.com

## Company
Oto Grade is Turkey's nationwide damaged vehicle buying service.
We purchase accident-damaged, written-off (pert), burnt, flood-damaged, scrap, engine-faulty, and heavily damaged vehicles at fair market prices.
Service area: All 81 provinces of Turkey.
Response time: Within 1 hour.
Pickup: Free doorstep pickup from any location in Turkey.

## Primary Service
- Turkish name: Hasarlı Araç Alımı
- English name: Damaged Vehicle Purchase
- We buy: Kazalı (accident), Pert (written-off), Yanmış (fire), Sel Hasarlı (flood), Hurda (scrap), Motor Arızalı (engine failure), Çekme Belgeli (tow certificate), Ağır Hasarlı (heavily damaged)
- Process: Free quote → Expert callback within 1 hour → Doorstep pickup → Payment on delivery
